//: The deno config for bundling @pancake/web (and the @pancake/stack graph it drives) for a browser. Maps the same package specifiers the root deno.json does, plus the two non-browser FFI host imports (node:net, bun:ffi) to browser stubs, so the stack's node/bun adapters — bundled but never selected once the web adapter is injected — resolve without pulling a runtime the browser lacks. Use with `deno bundle --platform browser --config bindings/ts/web/browser-bundle.json <entry>`.
